title: Settlement Agreements Policy on Combining Settlements: The Same-Client Bundle
content:
# Settlement Agreements — The Same-Client Bundle

**1. Only route for combining.** Under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements, settlements are combined across a consumer's accounts only through the same-client bundle.

**2. Forming a bundle.** When the consumer settles together every one of their open placed accounts placed under the same client agreement, the accounts number at least the programme's smallest bundle size, and every offer in the bundle uses a programme whose bundle floor reduction is above 0.0, each offer's floor is lowered by that programme's bundle floor reduction and the offers carry the bundle flag set to true.

> Clause 2 is **no longer in force** for offers priced under the current Two-Payment Settlement and Three-Payment Settlement offer pricing rules; for those offers it is superseded by the current basis of each rule.

**3. Who can and cannot be in a bundle.** Accounts under different client agreements never form a bundle, even when the original creditor is the same, and an account in dispute hold, or one that cannot take a settlement for any other reason, stops the bundle for every account under that agreement because the bundle must cover all of them.

> Clause 3 is **no longer in force** for offers priced under the current Two-Payment Settlement offer pricing rule; for those offers it is superseded by the current basis of that rule.

**4. One date, one programme.** All offers of a bundle are extended on the same offer date and use the same programme.

> Clause 4 is **no longer in force** for offers priced under the current Two-Payment Settlement and Three-Payment Settlement offer pricing rules; for those offers it is superseded by the current basis of each rule.

**5. Later events.** If any offer of a bundle later expires, defaults or is withdrawn, the other offers keep their terms; the reduction is not taken back.

## Programme figures read by this policy

Clause 2 reads, for each programme, its bundle floor reduction and its smallest bundle size, as the programme's same-client bundle figures give them. A programme whose bundle floor reduction is 0.0 contributes no bundle reduction.

## Points of judgement (clauses in force)

- **Does a lapse of one bundled offer undo the others?** No. Under clause 5 the remaining offers keep their terms and their reduction.
- **Can settlements on two accounts be combined other than as a same-client bundle?** No; clause 1 makes the bundle the only route.
